description_en: Queries the auto-renewal attributes of one or more reserved instances, including the auto-renewal duration and auto-renewal status
description_zh: 本接口用于查询一个或多个预留实例券自动续费属性，包括自动续费时长和自动续费状态
name: DescribeReservedInstanceAutoRenewAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the reserved instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to obtain the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
预留实例券所属的地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html获取最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the reserved instances. This parameter is required. If you do not specify this parameter, the MissingParamter.InstanceId error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 预留实例券ID数组。此参数为必填项，未提供时接口返回 MissingParamter.InstanceId
parameters.name: reserved_instance_id

ReservedInstanceRenewAttribute.description_en: The auto-renewal settings of the reserved instances. The value is an array of ReservedInstanceRenewAttribute objects
ReservedInstanceRenewAttribute.description_zh: 由ReservedInstanceRenewAttribute组成的数组格式，返回预留实例券的自动续费设置信息

PeriodUnit.description_en:
The unit of the renewal period.

<props="intl">Valid values: Year.</props>

<props="china">Valid values: Year and Month.</props>
PeriodUnit.description_zh:
续费单位。

<props="intl">可能值：Year。</props>

<props="china">可能值：Year、Month。</props>

RenewalStatus.description_en:
The auto-renewal status of the reserved instance. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: Auto-renewal.
Normal: Manual renewal
RenewalStatus.description_zh:
预留实例券自动续费状态。可能值：

AutoRenewal：自动续费。
Normal：手动续费

ReservedInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the reserved instance
